analytics.name: Analytic 1872
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies execution of network discovery tools (nmap, PLCScan, redpoint NSE scripts) or Industrial Control System (ICS)-specific scanners from an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host, from a process not associated with a recognized network management or engineering tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

tuning.description: IP allowlist of legitimate engineering and SCADA systems.
Allowlist of network management/diagnostic tools authorized for use on ICS hosts.
Time window within which sequential connections across the address range are considered a single discovery sweep event.

log_sources.channel: EventCode=1 of network discovery tool (nmap, PLCScan) from process not in authorized network tools list

analytics.name: Analytic 2171
analytics.guidance: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source generating Industrial Control System (ICS) discovery broadcasts or sequential connection attempts across the full IP range of a device subnet, from a source not in the approved engineering/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) inventory. Documented in the PIPEDREAM/INCONTROLLER toolset's CODECALL module for EtherNet/IP device discovery. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2172
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) echo sweeps, Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) broadcast floods, or Industrial Control System (ICS)-specific discovery protocol packets from a host generating traffic to all IPs in a subnet in sequential order, a sweep pattern distinct from normal operational traffic to known device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses only. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
